title: Glossary: classifier for outputs, supporting question for internal questions, plus feature
description:
Docs use 'classifier' both for an output and a sub-question.

Current: docs/glossary.md defines classifier as 'one question inside a cyclotron' and retires 'element'; README.md:595-600 keeps 'Decision element'; ClassifierSpec docstring says 'One decision question inside the cyclotron'; cyclotron_status.py:168 calls tasks 'classifier questions'; no glossary word for 'feature'.

Desired (approved by the site owner 2026-10-11): 'classifier' = each reviewed output (its result is a decision); 'supporting question' = internal question whose answer feeds that output's ML model as features; add 'feature'. Update docs, status UI and glossary tests.

Acceptance: no user-visible string calls a supporting question a 'classifier'; glossary tests enforce the terms.
